# ferentin_otel_sink (Resource)

A tenant OTEL sink — a telemetry destination (Datadog, Honeycomb, OTLP, …). Credentials for the sink are managed out-of-band via the `/credentials` sub-resource for v0.1; a future write-only `credentials` attribute is planned.

## Import

Existing sinks can be imported using `<tenant_id>/<sink_id>` (or `<sink_id>` alone when the provider's default `tenant_id` matches):

```
terraform import ferentin_otel_sink.example <tenant_id>/<sink_id>
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ferentin_otel_sink_provider" "otlp" {
  slug = "otlp"
}

resource "ferentin_otel_sink" "primary_otlp" {
  name      = "primary-otlp"
  endpoint  = "https://otel-collector.example.com:4318"
  sink_type = "otlp_http"

  provider_slug = data.ferentin_otel_sink_provider.otlp.slug
  protocol      = "http"
  compression   = "gzip"
  auth_type     = "bearer"
  timeout       = "30s"
  enabled       = true

  headers = {
    "X-Tenant" = "acme"
  }

  tags = {
    env = "prod"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) Sink endpoint URL.
- `name` (String)
- `sink_type` (String) Sink type. Allowed: `OTLP_GRPC`, `OTLP_HTTP`, `PROMETHEUS_REMOTE_WRITE`.

### Optional

- `auth_type` (String)
- `compression` (String) Compression type. Allowed: `gzip`, `none`, `zstd`.
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this sink is active. Default `true`.
- `headers` (Map of String) Custom HTTP headers sent on every export to this sink.
- `protocol` (String) Transport protocol. Allowed: `GRPC`, `HTTP`.
- `provider_slug` (String) Catalog provider slug — pull from `data "ferentin_otel_sink_provider"`.
- `region` (String)
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `timeout` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `has_credentials` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `sink_id` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `updated_by` (String)
